name: AT-rich interaction domain 4A
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ARID4A encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 4A. Annotated molecular activities include transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
